name: Zotero
description: Zotero is a free, easy-to-use tool to help you collect, organize, annotate, cite, and share research.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-zotero application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-zotero
  # The `big-bear-zotero` service definition
  big-bear-zotero:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-zotero
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: linuxserver/zotero:10.0.20260821@sha256:d201c7dd666842c8b6d06dee127052d6feae815dbbb0feba448c1182053598f9
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Environment variables for the container
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000"
      - 3001:3001
    security_opt:
      - seccomp:unconfined #optional
    shm_size: "1gb" #optional
